# Map scrap scroll

Based on Sketchfab “Scroll (game ready asset)” by Aparicio Silva 3D
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scroll-game-ready-asset-c1503d2292c74faebf83a5937646c1c7
License: CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Sketchfab requires an account to download the authored mesh. First Dive ships:
- `textures/albedo.jpg` (+ PBR maps) — full public atlas from the model
- `textures/parchment.jpg` — crop of the parchment UV island for the dive mesh
- Dive-tuned roll mesh in `src/scrollAsset.ts` (leather band, rope, wax seal)
